text:
harper: Quick thread: proposing an inline 'legend annotation' pattern for busy dashboards. Each legend row gets two micro-controls: a compact toggle and a clip badge that appears when values exceed a threshold. Mock attached.

anis: Love the micro-controls. Naming nit: 'clip' vs 'hide' vs 'trim'  'clip' feels technical, 'hide' feels destructive. Maybe 'trim' or 'compact' is friendlier.

mike: From product: prefer 'outliers' in copy — users understand that. Badge could say '2 outliers' and tooltip '2 outliers hidden — view'.

sophie: Accessibility: controls must be keyboard-reachable in legend order. Suggested aria-label: 'Toggle compact for series: Errors per min' and for badge '2 outliers hidden, press Enter to view'. Ensure aria-expanded on toggle and that the hidden values are present in DOM when collapsed.

kevin: Implementation: clipping rule proposal: values above 99.95th percentile OR > 50x median. Log analytics event `legend_clip` with `method=percentile|factor`. Also track whether users expand.

harper: Visual: when compacted show a 16px sparkline chip + median tick. If smoothing is applied on main chart show an 's' micro-icon on the chip.

anis: Behavior Q: auto-clip vs suggest-only? I'm against auto-clipping. Suggest a non-modal hint: 'Large spike detected. Compact high values?' with actions 'Compact'/'Show all'/'Don't ask again'. Default off.

mike: Agree. Also add a legend-context item 'Create outlier series' that extracts extremes into a separate series so power users can inspect spikes without losing context.

sophie: Keyboard shortcut idea: focus legend, press 't' to toggle compact for focused series; press 'o' to open outlier list. Document in shortcuts.

kevin: Edge case: stacked or percent-stacked charts. Disable clip controls there and show tooltip 'Not supported for stacked views'.

ui-bot: asset-uploader: uploaded mock v1 to figs/legend-anno-v1.png at 1777777840.

harper: I'll update mocks with two copy variants (short + friendly) and include a keyboard flow and a small a11y checklist. Posting updated images in this thread in a few hours. Thanks for the quick inputs! :sparkles:
